title: Yellowed Crispy Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A cultured and flaky Malaysian dish featuring passion fruit pulp, this chicken satay is a crowd-pleaser, made with air-fry and raw-friendly ingredients for a unique twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, passion fruit pulp, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
Add the chicken breast strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the air fryer for 10 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Increase the air fryer temperature to 420 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the chicken satay hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and passion fruit pulp if desired.
